key_points: Oppenheimer raises MSFT price target to $570, citing AI growth and cost discipline.
Microsoft announces an 8% dividend increase and $223 billion returned to shareholders via buybacks/dividends.
Premarket strength ahead of Q4 results, with focus on Azure capex and growth expectations.
Copilot AI subscriptions to receive 30-50% discounts for large enterprise customers to drive adoption.
Trump's disclosed sales of up to $25M in Microsoft shares create noise but no material impact.
